summary: Establish one EKODI-owned external canonical surface under ekodi.kr paths while preserving internal runtime, security, protocol and deployment boundaries by responsibility.
approvalBasis: The platform owner explicitly approved consistent external ekodi.kr routing with separated internal services and requested that the rule be recorded, managed and operated as repository constitution.
rules: All EKODI-owned externally presented canonical URLs use ekodi.kr paths.
Internal subdomains and Workers may remain separated for responsibility, security, protocol, deployment and service-to-service execution.
Internal runtime hostnames do not become external canonical URLs merely because they are reachable.
Customer-owned domains remain governed external exceptions and never become EKODI identity authority.
External canonical path convergence is compatibility-first; destructive DNS or security-boundary cutovers require a staged C3 migration.
rollback: Revert the v1.8.4 constitutional, registry, policy and validator changes. This amendment performs no destructive DNS, data or production runtime cutover, so rollback leaves existing runtime boundaries intact.
verification: validate constitution and platform boundary registries
run focused external canonical surface contract tests
run repository check and test suites before merge
